paragraphs: Orange Data sells three services to local government departments, described on its own site as a way to automate third-party data requests, reduce manual work, and improve fee collection. The first, Lien Search Fulfillment, covers the lien search process from request to delivery. A second service, Lien Settlement, works with property owners to settle code liens. Public Records Management accepts, tracks, and delivers public records requests through a single portal.

The pages name cities and counties of all sizes as the customers served, and name public or private utilities as well. Departments listed include tax collectors, code enforcement, building departments, utility departments, and law enforcement. Each service runs on a per-transaction model where the fees are paid by the requester, and collected funds are remitted directly to the agency.

Orange Data was founded by Stewart Holley, a veteran and former local government elected official, and David Harrington, a Title Insurance industry expert. The about page states the aim as helping local governments do more with less, at no cost to taxpayers.
